outcome_evidence: In base_image, the robot separates the initially nested cups (frames 350–700), places two cups side by side, and builds a three-cup pyramid visible at frame 1000. It then lifts the upper cup (frames 1100–1200) and gathers the cups into a compact nested stack (frames 1398–1600). The stack remains stable with both grippers clear at frames 1700–1727. “Pack” is interpreted as nesting the cups together; no separate packaging destination is shown. No failed acquisition, dropped cup, or unintended side effect is established.
